warnings.headline: Yellow Near gale 14-17 m/s Sea of Aaland
warnings.description:
Late Sunday afternoon south 14-17 m/s.; What should I think about?: Pay close attention to the marine forecast and prepare crew and vessel for high winds and seas.
Keep in mind that the wind gusts are often significantly higher than the average wind.; Where?: Sea of Aaland
warnings.sender: SMHI, Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute
